how_to_apply: Fill the application in the prescribed proforma (Application form for the Deputation Post) enclosed with the notice.
Forward the application through proper channel with NOC, Vigilance Clearance and APARs for the last five years.

Complete application must be received at Deputy Director (Pers.), Central Electricity Authority, Sewa Bhawan, R.K. Puram, New Delhi-110066 by 07-12-2026.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for CEA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 7 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in CEA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: 1 Private Secretary, 1 Stenographer Grade-I.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for CEA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Application form for the Deputation Post enclosed with the notice (pages 3-6 of the PDF)) and send it to Deputy Director (Pers.), Central Electricity Authority, Sewa Bhawan, R.K. Puram, New Delhi-110066, by through proper channel, to reach by 7 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 56 years (as on the closing date of receipt of applications).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Level-7 [Rs. 44,900-1,42,400] for Private Secretary, Level-6 [Rs. 35,400-1,12,400] for Stenographer Grade-I.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Officers holding the post of Stenographer under the Central Government. Private Secretary: analogous post on regular basis, or 05 years regular service in the Stenographers Grade in Level-6 or equivalent. Stenographer Grade-I: analogous post on regular basis, or 10 years regular service in Level-4 or equivalent. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Open to officers holding the post of Stenographer on a regular basis under the Central Government.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Departmental officers in the feeder category who are in the direct line of promotion are not eligible for appointment on deputation. Deputationists are not eligible for consideration for appointment by promotion.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Selection on deputation basis from eligible officers holding analogous posts.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Period of deputation will be three years as per rules. Deputation period, including immediately preceding ex-cadre deputation in the same or other Central Government organisation, shall ordinarily not exceed three years.
